In the bigger picture, we could consider investors might wonder if the NASDAQ just had another summer-sized correction and might now find support. Lastly, we might consider the bond market correction has similarly covered enough ground as to merit a bit of cooling. All of that is speculative, of course. If stocks resume tanking or if the econ data gets bad, the good times could easily resume.
